title: UltraEvent v1
description: Exact wire copy of platform/services/ultra-core-bridge/src/types.ts UltraEvent. Signed, hash-chained event emitted by Ultra AI. No tokens, wallets, mining, rewards, or chain data.

type.description: usage.* | contribution.* | provenance.* — namespaced event type.

subject.description: Platform instance / deployment identifier plus optional agent and session ids.

payload.description: Event payload. Treated as opaque data by Ultra-Core; must never carry chain keys, wallet material, or executable instructions.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event in the chain (sha256:<hex>); genesis is sha256: + 64 zeroes.

key_id.description: Public key reference — never private material.

value.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical wire form (ADR-0001); base64 tolerated by receivers during transition.
